text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager duty: HIGH priority - service: text-generation-us-east - alert: p99 inference latency > 3s for 15m

Sara (primary): late handoff here, leaving in 30m. quick summary: p99 spike started ~14:50 UTC, affects hosted text-gen (gptx-medium) in us-east. error rates still low but latency and request queue depth high. customers seeing slow responses, some timing out at frontend.

Mike (secondary): confirmed. dashboards: cpu on primary gpu nodes at ~92%, queue depth up to 120k reqs, autoscaler is not adding nodes fast enough due to quota errors.

Sara (primary): mitigations in progress:
- throttling rule deployed to ingress to shed low-priority traffic (prefix /playground) :white_check_mark:
- temporary increase of bursting quota requested from infra (ticket #INC-3482) - awaiting approval
- manual scale: spun up 4 spare inference pools (prim/sec) in us-east (still initializing)
- enabled fallback routing to eu-west for non-geolocked customers

Nina (oncall-lead): customer impact? which customers hit? any paying customers timed out?

Sara (primary): Triage notes: two mid-tier customers reported 504s on product pages (support tickets linked). highest-impact customer is acme-corp (rate limited but still with degraded latency). No enterprise incidents opened yet.

Mike (secondary): runbook refs: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/inference-ratewave (see 'ratewave -> ingress-ops' section). key commands:
```
# check queue depth
curl -s http://ops-api/internal/queues/textgen | jq .depth
# force-add pool
opsctl pool add --region us-east --type gpu --count 2 --flavor p4d
```

Sara (primary): current blockers:
- infra quota approval slow (cloud team backlogged)
- longer-tail KV cache thrash on prim nodes causing slowdowns for repeated prefixes

OpsBot: Note: autoscaler returns 429 for new pool requests - quota_exceeded. Ticket opened with cloud-quotas.

Mike (secondary): temporary workarounds:
- increase per-customer rate limit for enterprise plan (acme-corp) so fewer requests queue per token - manual override applied for acme-corp at 15:10 UTC
- enable prefix caching for high-volume endpoints (deployed)

Sara (primary): checklist for incoming oncall (Mike, assuming you'll take over):
- verify the 4 pools finished init and are serving: `opsctl pool list --region us-east`
- monitor p99 every 5m and check queue depth alerts
- if autoscaler starts failing, fall back to ingress throttling policy v2 (path: /ops/config/throttle-v2)
- escalate to infra if quota ticket not resolved in 20m, ping oncall-infra channel and tag @lisa-infra
- keep support informed of acme-corp ticket, share temporary override and ETA for full restore

Mike (secondary): I'll take handoff at 15:30 UTC. immediate actions on my side: confirm pools, keep fallback routing active, watch for KV thrash revert after caching.

Sara (primary): logs to check:
- /var/log/inference/proxy.log for 5xx and timeout messages
- traces in honeycomb: dataset=prod-inference, trace name=serve_request

Nina (oncall-lead): suggested escalation criteria:
- p99 > 3s for 30m and > 10% customer timeout -> conference and pager escalation
- any enterprise customer 504s > 5m -> open SEV and notify CS

Mike (secondary): noted. I'll also prepare rollback plan for latest routing change in case caches make things worse:
- rollback command: `opsctl config apply --file /deploys/ingress-routing-prev.json`

Sara (primary): leaving note: I set a slack reminder for 20m to check quota ticket status. if you need me after I log off ping oncall-mobile. thanks team :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: Pager cleared? No - alert still firing.

Mike (secondary): taking over now. I'll update every 15 min or on status change. first update: pools show 3/4 active, one in init (ci logs show image pull slow). queue depth dropping slowly from 120k -> 85k in last 10m. p99 down to 2.9s.

Nina (oncall-lead): good handoff. keep docs updated and paste key links into ticket. also add 'what fixed it' note later for postmortem.

Mike (secondary): Will do. adding to incident ticket: https://tracker.internal/INC-3482.

Sara (primary): ack. have a good shift.
